description: This file defines the ZoneStatusChangedEvent class, which extends ClusterCommandEvent, representing a specific event related to zone status changes in a Zigbee-like protocol. It constructs a payload for this event and is part of a mock Zigbee core event system.

classes.name: ZoneStatusChangedEvent
classes.description: Represents a zone status change event with capability to generate its payload.

methods.name: ZoneStatusChangedEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with EUI64, endpoint ID, zone ID, and flags.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Constructs and returns the command payload as a byte array, formatted in little-endian order.
